source.notionDatabase: Futrob — Breakdown de tareas del MVP

tests.given: an Encounter with officialMatchCount 1, two distinct window candidates, and a captain actor with propose
tests.when: the client POSTs /api/v1/encounters/{id}/official-selection with one valid ExternalReference and service-auth headers
tests.then: status is 201, body status is awaiting_opponent_confirmation, and the outbox contains results.official-matches-selected

tests.given: the same Encounter and an actor from another organization
tests.when: that actor POSTs the same path
tests.then: status is 404 and body code is results.encounter_not_found

tests.given: a valid body and no Authorization header
tests.when: the client POSTs the selection path
tests.then: status is 401 and body code is api.unauthorized

tests.given: officialMatchCount 2 and a body with one slot
tests.then: status is 400 and body code is results.invalid_selection

tests.given: two slots that repeat the same providerKey and externalId
tests.then: status is 400 and body code is results.duplicate_provider_match

tests.given: a selection in awaiting_opponent_confirmation and the rival captain
tests.then: status is 200, OfficialResult.status is approved, revision is 1, and the outbox contains exactly one results.official-result-approved

tests.given: that approved result
tests.when: the rival confirms again with the same idempotency key
tests.then: status is 200, revision stays 1, and no second results.official-result-approved is published

tests.given: a JSON body that sets role to organizer
tests.when: an actor without propose posts selection
tests.then: status is 404 and body code is results.encounter_not_found

tests.given: no selection
tests.then: status is 404 and body code is results.selection_not_found

tests.given: OpenAPI generated from futrobOpenApiV1
tests.then: POST /encounters/{encounterId}/official-selection, confirm POST, and disputes POST exist with ApiError 401 and 404

tests.given: mockFetch that expects POST .../encounters/encounter-1/official-selection and returns id sel-1 with status awaiting_opponent_confirmation
tests.then: the resolved value status is awaiting_opponent_confirmation and id is sel-1

tests.given: a confirm response with id result-1, status approved, revision 1
tests.then: revision is 1 and status is approved

tests.given: a 404 body { "code": "results.encounter_not_found" }
tests.then: the SDK throws FutrobApiError whose code is results.encounter_not_found

tests.given: rejectOfficialSelection and openMatchDispute on the resource
tests.when: each is called with a valid body
tests.then: fetch uses POST on /encounters/encounter-1/official-selection/reject and /encounters/encounter-1/disputes

tests.given: a confirm payload with status "done"
tests.then: Zod throws

tests.given: the existing candidates tests
tests.then: listEncounterCandidates still requests GET /encounters/encounter-1/candidates

tests.given: a captain session and a loader that returns two candidates and allowed containing encounters.official-selection.propose
tests.then: both team names, kickoff, two official slots, and a propose control with accessible name are in the document

tests.given: a player roster role on a participating Team, allowed with encounters.read only
tests.then: candidates may be hidden or read-only and no propose, confirm, or dispute button is present

tests.given: status clubs_not_connected and sides ["away"]
tests.then: the empty copy names the away club connection, not a generic void

tests.given: five candidate rows with hour, score, duration, sides, and completeness partial
tests.then: all five stay unofficial and the partial flag is visible

tests.given: a selection awaiting_opponent_confirmation proposed by the other captain
tests.when: the rival captain views Official matches and Selection
tests.then: confirm and reject controls are present and propose is not the primary action

tests.given: no permission to read the Encounter
tests.then: the user sees the 403 pattern, not an empty Match Center

tasks.tarea: [Domain] Asociación persistida de candidatos + recálculo tras reprogramación

tests.given: both clubs connected and three ProviderMatch rows, two inside the window and one outside
tests.when: ListEncounterCandidatesUseCase runs after a persist-association step
tests.then: the stored association count is 2 and the ready payload candidates length is 2 with those externalId values

tests.given: those two association rows
tests.when: the same associate command runs again with the same matches
tests.then: row count stays 2 and primary keys do not change

tests.given: associations for kickoff T and a later scheduling.encounter-rescheduled to T+24h
tests.then: rows that leave the new window stay stored with eligibility false, new in-window matches insert, and selected ExternalReference values are unchanged

tests.given: a second identical reschedule event
tests.then: no extra rows and eligibility flags match the first recalc

tests.given: a selected ref that is no longer eligible after recalc
tests.when: SelectOfficialMatchesUseCase is asked to propose a different ineligible ref
tests.then: the error code is results.invalid_selection or results.candidate_not_associated, and the original selection row still has the old ref

tests.given: candidateWindowFor(new Date("2026-09-14T20:00:00.000Z"))
tests.then: from is 2026-09-14T14:00:00.000Z and to is 2026-09-15T02:00:00.000Z if DEC-023 6 hours wins, or keep 18 hours only after an explicit product decision

tasks.tarea: [Domain] Rechazo, selección alternativa y disputa completa

tests.given: selection awaiting_opponent_confirmation proposed by captain A
tests.then: latest selection status is selection_in_progress or disputed per the chosen machine, OfficialResult is absent, and results.official-result-approved is not published

tests.given: that proposal
tests.when: captain B proposes a different slot set
tests.then: status becomes organizer_review or disputed, no OfficialResult is saved, and statistics are not projected

tests.given: two captains who post the same slot set
tests.when: the second confirm runs and completeness is complete
tests.then: one OfficialResult with revision 1 and status approved exists, and results.official-result-approved is published once

tests.given: captain A as proposer
tests.when: captain A confirms their own proposal without organizer permission
tests.then: the error is results.selection_not_confirmable or results.official_result_forbidden

tests.given: disputed
tests.when: an organizer with encounters.results.approve resolves for A's slots
tests.then: OfficialResult.status is approved and results.match-dispute-opened had already been published on open

tests.given: approved
tests.then: SelectionNotConfirmable or a new tagged code and the approved snapshot is unchanged

tests.given: a switch over SelectionStatus
tests.then: the default never check fails to compile

tests.given: a knockout Encounter whose next round away slot is { kind: "winner", encounterId: "enc-1" } and an approved OfficialResult where home scored more aggregate goals
tests.then: that away slot is { kind: "team", teamId: homeTeamId } and the league standings table is unchanged

tests.given: format league and the same approved result
tests.then: no FixtureParticipantSlot mutates and standings still come only from ProjectOfficialResultUseCase

tests.given: a bye slot
tests.then: the bye remains { kind: "bye" } with no fabricated score

tests.given: aggregate_score series 1-1 on slots then 2-0
tests.then: the winner is the team with aggregate 3-1, not the team that won more official matches

tests.given: an approved result later voided
tests.then: the downstream slot returns to { kind: "winner", encounterId: "enc-1" } and occupancy hasApprovedOfficialResult is false

tests.given: an elimination draw with no configured tie-break data
tests.then: a tagged error such as scheduling.tie_requires_organizer_review and no slot write

tests.given: no prior selection
tests.then: one audit row has actorId A, action propose, before null, after.slots[0].providerMatchRef.externalId m-1, and occurredAt the clock instant

tests.given: that proposal
tests.then: a second row has action confirm, before.status awaiting_opponent_confirmation, after.status approved, and no provider payload blob

tests.given: a dispute reason "call me at +1-555-0100"
tests.then: stored after-image reason is a safe token or redacted string, not the phone number

tests.given: the same confirm replay with the same request id
tests.then: audit row count for that request id stays 1

tests.given: an ea-clubs id already approved on Encounter 1
tests.then: the command fails with a tagged uniqueness error and an audit row records the attempt

tests.given: org A, two connected clubs, one in-window ProviderMatch, captain A and captain B on opposite Teams
tests.when: A posts selection and B posts confirm through createApp
tests.then: HTTP 200, official_results.status is approved, revision is 1, player_match_contributions has one row for that match externalPlayerId, and events are results.official-matches-selected then results.official-result-approved

tests.given: that approved Encounter
tests.then: HTTP 200, still revision 1, still one contribution row, still one approved event

tests.given: the same headers against org B Encounter id
tests.then: 404 results.encounter_not_found and org B tables are empty of A's selection

tests.given: awaiting confirmation
tests.then: HTTP 200 or 409 per the domain contract, official_results has no approved row, and body code is a stable results.* code

tests.given: slot count mismatch
tests.then: 400 results.invalid_selection

tests.given: duplicate provider ref across slots
tests.then: 400 results.duplicate_provider_match

tests.given: missing provider snapshot at confirm
tests.then: 409 or 404 results.provider_match_snapshot_missing and no official row

tests.given: npm run cli -- results-smoke
tests.then: keep it as a domain smoke, and add a live CLI path only after HTTP exists
